profile:
COMPANY NAME: Live Nation
INDUSTRY: Live Entertainment / Ticketing
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: A comprehensive platform for purchasing tickets to live events, including concerts, festivals, and comedy shows, along with VIP packages, merchandise, and livestreams.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: General consumers and fans of live music, sports, and entertainment seeking tickets, premium experiences, and artist merchandise.
PRICING MODEL: Transaction-based (ticket sales, merchandise sales, and premium package fees)
KEY FEATURES:
- Ticket sales for concerts, festivals, and comedy
- VIP packages including meet & greets, exclusive lounges, and special merchandise
- Artist presale access and sign-ups
- Merchandise store for tour-specific apparel
- Livestreams of live performances and premieres
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Exclusive access to VIP experiences and presales; wide variety of event types (music, comedy, festivals); integrated merchandise and livestream offerings.
TONE & POSITIONING: Consumer-focused / Premium (via VIP offerings) / Entertainment
